svg.text: FleetPanda AI System — End-to-End User Journey & Architecture
Complete interaction lifecycle with explicit LLM model calls and pure deterministic Python stages

g.text: 1. Scope command (`use CFS` / `platform`) | 2. Dispatch Question (`How many deliveries...`) | 3. Ticket Triage (`triage 1083` / pasted ticket)
Pure rendering adapters · Zero business logic
• Captures typed commands & multi-line ticket pastes
• Formats full ANSI terminal output, raw SQL queries, & 25-line triage brief tables
• Push-to-talk microphone capture • normalize_transcript() acronyms & digit commas
• speakable() transforms ISO dates for natural speech • Spoken brief cut to level + 2 reasons
• Gate is candidate COUNT, not score (fail closed D-003)
• Returns CONFIRM if inexact (arms confirmation gate)
• Heuristic regex first (ticket IDs, keywords, ? marks)
• LLM Fallback ONLY if ambiguous (saves ~1s voice latency)
• Question + Introspected Schema Card + Date Anchor ('2026-05-29')
• Outputs structured JSON: {sql, is_cross_tenant, assumptions} (Validated via Pydantic)
• _authority_check() refuses cross-tenant queries in bound sessions
• sqlglot AST parse: rejects non-SELECT, multi-stmt, PRAGMA/ATTACH/VACUUM
• Injects 'tenant_id = N' on every direct FROM/JOIN in every SELECT scope | Limit 200
• Receives verified SQLite rows + question + date anchor
• Computes ZERO arithmetic (SQLite did 100%) $\to$ Generates 2 conversational sentences
• Parses subject, priority, product_area from pasted text
• Binds tenant from session context, NEVER from untrusted text (D-022)
• Signals: health < 40 (+30), contract expired (+25), CARR $\ge$ 72k (+15), duplicate cluster (+20)
• Account cap = 55 pts (D-012): bad account alone cannot trigger CRITICAL ($\ge 70$)
• Dual Clocks: Data max date (2026-05-29) vs Real CRM calendar for contracts
• Handed pre-computed escalation level & audit signals (LLM gets ZERO vote on score)
• Synthesises concise, human-readable CSM customer brief narrative
• Prints synthesised prose + executed SQL + tabular rows + full 25-line triage audit brief.
• Pure Python string formatting with ANSI color codes.
• Prose only (SQL never spoken); brief truncated to level + top 2 drivers; dates spoken as words.
• OpenAI TTS-1 synthesised audio streamed to speaker.
